012/**
013 * Enhanced Command Factory with optimized integration capabilities.
014 *
015 * <p>This factory extends AbstractFactory to provide enhanced command creation with:
016 *
017 * <ul>
018 *   <li>Intelligent caching with configurable cache policies
019 *   <li>Unified error handling and logging integration
020 *   <li>Performance optimizations for high-throughput scenarios
021 *   <li>Seamless integration with ControllerFactory
022 *   <li>Backward compatibility with existing CommandFactory API
023 * </ul>
024 *
025 * <p>This class addresses Issue #124 by providing optimized integration between CommandFactory and
026 * ControllerFactory, reducing redundancy while maintaining backward compatibility.
027 *
028 * <p>Usage examples:
029 *
030 * <pre>
031 * // Static methods (backward compatible)
032 * IStreamCommand command = EnhancedCommandFactory.createWithLogging(CsvNavigateCommand.class, "name");
033 *
034 * // Instance methods with configuration
035 * EnhancedCommandFactory factory = new EnhancedCommandFactory(FactoryConfiguration.productionConfig());
036 * IStreamCommand cached = factory.createCached(JsonNavigateCommand.class, "$.user");
037 *
038 * // Pipeline creation with optimization
039 * IStreamCommand[] pipeline = factory.createPipelineOptimized(
040 *     CommandConfig.of(CsvNavigateCommand.class, "name"),
041 *     CommandConfig.of(JsonNavigateCommand.class, "$.user.name")
042 * );
043 * </pre>
044 *
045 * @since 1.0
046 */
047public class EnhancedCommandFactory extends AbstractFactory<IStreamCommand> {
048  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(EnhancedCommandFactory.class);
049
050  /** Default singleton instance for static methods */
051  private static final EnhancedCommandFactory DEFAULT_INSTANCE = new EnhancedCommandFactory();
052

069  /**
070   * Creates command with logging using default instance. Maintains backward compatibility with
071   * existing CommandFactory.
072   *
073   * @param <T> command type
074   * @param commandClass command class
075   * @param args constructor arguments
076   * @return command with logging enabled
077   */
078  public static <T extends IStreamCommand> T createWithLogging(
079      Class<T> commandClass, Object... args) {
080    try {
081      return DEFAULT_INSTANCE.createCommandWithLogging(commandClass, false, args);
082    } catch (FactoryException e) {
083      throw new RuntimeException("Command creation failed: " + commandClass.getSimpleName(), e);
084    }
085  }

193  // ========== Enhanced Instance Methods ==========

195  /**
196   * Creates command with caching support.
197   *
198   * @param <T> command type
199   * @param commandClass command class
200   * @param args constructor arguments
201   * @return cached or newly created command
202   * @throws FactoryException if creation fails
203   */
204  public <T extends IStreamCommand> T createCached(Class<T> commandClass, Object... args)
205      throws FactoryException {
206    String cacheKey = createCacheKey(commandClass.getName(), args);
207
208    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
209    T cached = (T) getCachedInstance(cacheKey);
210    if (cached != null) {
211      log.debug("Retrieved cached command: {} (key: {})", commandClass.getSimpleName(), cacheKey);
212      return cached;
213    }
214
215    T command = createCommandWithLogging(commandClass, config.isDetailedLoggingEnabled(), args);
216    cacheInstance(cacheKey, command);
217    return command;
218  }

228      throws FactoryException {
229    return createPipeline(configs, config.isDetailedLoggingEnabled());

249  // ========== Private Implementation Methods ==========
250
251  /**
252   * Creates Navigate command using factory methods if applicable. This method handles the new API
253   * for Navigate commands that no longer have deprecated constructors.
254   *
255   * @param <T> command type
256   * @param commandClass the command class
257   * @param args constructor arguments
258   * @return created command or null if not applicable
259   * @throws FactoryException if creation fails
260   */
261  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
262  private <T extends IStreamCommand> Optional<T> createNavigateCommandIfApplicable(
263      Class<T> commandClass, Object... args) throws FactoryException {
264
265    String className = commandClass.getSimpleName();
266
267    if ("JsonNavigateCommand".equals(className)) {
268      return createJsonNavigateCommand(commandClass, args);
269    } else if ("CsvNavigateCommand".equals(className)) {
270      return createCsvNavigateCommand(commandClass, args);
271    } else if ("XmlNavigateCommand".equals(className)) {
272      return createXmlNavigateCommand(commandClass, args);
273    }
274    return Optional.empty();
275  }
276
277  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
278  private <T extends IStreamCommand> Optional<T> createJsonNavigateCommand(
279      Class<T> commandClass, Object... args) throws FactoryException {
280    try {
281      // We need to add PassThroughRule as second argument for factory method
282      com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule defaultRule =
283          new com.streamConverter.command.rule.PassThroughRule();
284
285      if (args.length == 1) {
286        // Single argument - use create(path, rule)
287        Object path = args[0];
288        return Optional.of(
289            (T)
290                com.streamConverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand.create(
291                    (String) path, defaultRule));
292      } else if (args.length == 0) {
293        // No arguments - use createForAll(rule)
294        return Optional.of(
295            (T)
296                com.streamConverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand.createForAll(
297                    defaultRule));
298      } else if (args.length == 2 && args[1] instanceof com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule) {
299        // Two arguments (String path, IRule) - use create(path, rule)
300        String path = (String) args[0];
301        com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule rule =
302            (com.streamConverter.command.rule.IRule) args[1];
303        return Optional.of(
304            (T) com.streamConverter.command.impl.json.JsonNavigateCommand.create(path, rule));
305      } else {
306        // Other argument patterns - throw exception rather than returning empty
307        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
308            "JsonNavigateCommand factory method does not support "
309                + args.length
310                + " arguments of the given types");
311      }
312    } catch (Exception e) {
313      throw new FactoryException("Failed to create JsonNavigateCommand: " + e.getMessage(), e);
314    }
315  }
316

383  /** Core command creation method with logging integration. */
384  @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
385  private <T extends IStreamCommand> T createCommandWithLogging(
386      Class<T> commandClass, boolean enableDetailedLogging, Object... args)
387      throws FactoryException {
388
389    Optional<T> navigateResult = createNavigateCommandIfApplicable(commandClass, args);
390    if (navigateResult.isPresent()) {
391      T command = navigateResult.get();
392
393      if (config.isDetailedLoggingEnabled() || enableDetailedLogging) {
394        log.info(
395            "Created command instance: {} with {} args (detailed logging: {})",
396            commandClass.getSimpleName(),
397            args.length,
398            enableDetailedLogging);
399      }
400
401      // Handle logging decoration
402      if (command instanceof AbstractStreamCommand) {
403        // AbstractStreamCommand already has integrated logging
404        return command;
405      } else if (enableDetailedLogging) {
406        // Wrap with LoggingDecorator for non-AbstractStreamCommand instances
407        return (T) new LoggingDecorator(command);
408      } else {
409        return command;
410      }
411    } else {
412      T command = createInstance(commandClass, args);
413
414      if (config.isDetailedLoggingEnabled() || enableDetailedLogging) {
415        log.info(
416            "Created command instance: {} with {} args (detailed logging: {})",
417            commandClass.getSimpleName(),
418            args.length,
419            enableDetailedLogging);
420      }
421
422      // Handle logging decoration
423      if (command instanceof AbstractStreamCommand) {
424        // AbstractStreamCommand already has integrated logging
425        return command;
426      } else if (enableDetailedLogging) {
427        // Wrap with LoggingDecorator for non-AbstractStreamCommand instances
428        return (T) new LoggingDecorator(command);
429      } else {
430        return command;
431      }
432    }
433  }
434
435  /** Creates pipeline with specified logging configuration. */
436  private IStreamCommand[] createPipeline(CommandConfig[] configs, boolean enableDetailedLogging)
437      throws FactoryException {
438    List<IStreamCommand> commands = new ArrayList<>();
439
440    log.info(
441        "Creating pipeline with {} commands (detailed logging: {})",
442        configs.length,
443        enableDetailedLogging);
444
445    for (int i = 0; i < configs.length; i++) {
446      CommandConfig config = configs[i];
447      try {
448        IStreamCommand command =
449            createCommandWithLogging(
450                config.getCommandClass(), enableDetailedLogging, config.getArgs());
451        commands.add(command);
452
453        if (log.isDebugEnabled()) {
454          log.debug("Added command {}/{}: {}", i + 1, configs.length, config.getDescription());
455        }
456      } catch (Exception e) {
457        String message =
458            String.format(
459                "Failed to create command %d/%d: %s",
460                i + 1, configs.length, config.getDescription());
461        log.error(message, e);
462
463        if (this.config.isFailFastOnError()) {
464          throw new FactoryException(message, e);
465        }
466        // Continue with next command if fail-fast is disabled
467      }
468    }
469
470    log.info("Created pipeline with {}/{} commands successfully", commands.size(), configs.length);
471    return commands.toArray(new IStreamCommand[0]);
472  }
